title: Understanding Inertia and Distortion
text: Inertia is the sum of squared distances from each point to its assigned cluster center. Distortion is the average of these squared distances. How might these two quantities relate to each other?

title: Calculating Inertia and Distortion
text: To calculate inertia, sum up the squared distances from each point to its cluster center. For distortion, divide this sum by the number of points. What does this tell you about the relationship between inertia and distortion?

title: Relationship Between Inertia and Distortion
text: If inertia is the sum of squared distances and distortion is the average, what is the relationship between inertia and distortion in terms of the number of points, $$n$$?
